name: luci-app-footstrap-files-tooling
description: Build and check tooling only. NOTHING here is shipped: the package payload is browser JS, one stylesheet and the vendored editor, and a router never runs node. terser and acorn are what tools/minify-js.mjs uses to pre-minify the staged JS; the OpenWrt SDK path needs neither.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run css-contract && npm run t0 && npm run i18n-packages && npm run i18n
